newsitem.title: USA: Chile's Maderas y Sinteticos Q2 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Maderas y Sinteticos Q2 net rises.

text.p: Maderas y Sintticos SA (Masisa) on Wednesday reported second quarter net income of $4.8 million, or $0.19 per American Depositary Share, on operating revenues of $53.8 million.

The net income figure was up four percent from the same period a year ago in terms of Chilean pesos, and up eight percent in U.S. dollar terms, the company said in a news release made available in the United States.
Revenues for the quarter were up 34 percent in peso terms and 39 percent in dollar terms.
Operating income for the quarter was $9.7 million, up 153 percent in pesos and 163 percent in dollars.
For the first six months of 1997, net income was $12.2 million, or $0.50 per ADS, on operating revenues of $102.6 million.
Net income for the period was up 2.5 percent in pesos and seven percent in dollar terms, while revenues for the six months were up 35 percent in pesos and 40 percent in dollars.
Operating income for the six-month period was $18.1 million, up 114 percent in pesos and 122 percent in dollar terms.
